requirements.title: Account-free default and passwordless account sign-in
requirements.description: Keep the core product account-free unless persistent user identity is essential. If accounts are introduced, implement account-scoped sync where needed and verify passwordless sign-in using passkeys and external FIDO2 keys.
requirements.condition: Account-specific requirements apply only if Aurea introduces user accounts.
requirements.verification: Review authentication and storage architecture. If accounts exist, verify platform passkeys and real external keys, recovery and revocation.
requirements.exceptionPolicy: Explicit scoped approval and review date required.
